title: Claude Motion Designer Reel (Bauhaus shapes)
summary: A 15 s motion-design showreel built around a single orange-red dot. The dot squash-and-stretches on a ruler, becomes the tittle of the i in 'motion design', expands into a full-screen orange circle, then the film cycles through Bauhaus tile patterns (yellow/blue/black), wavy line patterns, a dotted particle sphere, cobalt-blue data bars and counters, and ends on 'claude. motion designer'. Technical HUD labels everywhere (FIG. 03 SQUASH + STRETCH, 120 BPM 60 FPS).
fit_reason: The single-dot continuity and clean HUD labels are premium and transferable; Bauhaus patterns are more design-studio than B2B.

palette.mood: high-contrast Bauhaus: near-black and warm off-white grounds with vermilion, cobalt and saffron

typography.display: ultra-heavy wide grotesk (Archivo Black / Archivo 900 wide) + light serif italic subline
typography.size_behaviour: huge centred two-line stack; tiny mono HUD labels in corners
typography.notes: Orange dot always replaces the tittle of the i and the full stop ('claude.'). HUD: timecode + '120 BPM 60 FPS' top-right, section labels '01 / TYPE', '02 / SHAPE', '05 / DATA' bottom-left, a mini progress line bottom-right.

text_animation: word slides in horizontally with motion blur on baseline guides (TITLE / X-HEIGHT / BASELINE labels)
second word builds bottom-up letter-by-letter with letters rising from below a mask
motion: squash and stretch bounce with onion-skin trails
dot scales up to fill the frame
tile pattern cascade where each cell flips to a new shape on beat
particle sphere rotating then flattening into a wave plane
line chart draws with dot leading
transitions: match on the orange dot across every scene
graphic_elements: Bauhaus tiles (quarter circles, triangles, stripes, diamonds)

sound.music: minimal electronic at 120 BPM (labelled on screen)
sound.sfx: boings on bounce, ticks, clicks on tile flips

signature_moves: one orange dot as the hero that becomes the i's tittle and the full stop
squash + stretch intro on a measured ruler with FIG. labels
Bauhaus tile grid that re-shuffles on the beat

best_segments.what: Dot squash-and-stretch on ruler, becomes the tittle in 'motion design' type build
Full-screen orange expand, Bauhaus tile and wave patterns flipping on beat
Cobalt data scene (pill bars, counters, line chart) then 'claude. motion designer' end card

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP/Remotion with SVG: spring-eased squash/stretch, variable font axis animation (Archivo wdth/wght), SVG tile grid swapped per beat, canvas particles for the sphere.
recreate.prompt: Bauhaus motion reel: a single vermilion dot bounces with squash-and-stretch on a ruler, becomes the dot of the i in a heavy wide lowercase word, then flips through yellow/blue/black geometric tile grids and cobalt data bars on a 120 BPM beat with tiny HUD labels in the corners.
